pagerduty-bot: PD-1927700321 triggered for service=model-serving - high tail latency detected at 2026-11-02T04:32:01Z

Alex K: acking, jumping in. seeing p95 ~1.4s, p50 drifted a bit too. Starting investigation.

Sam P: any 5xx or client timeouts?

Alex K: error rate stable. No 429s. Looks like an intermittent tail-only event.

ops-bot: runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/model-serving#tail-latency

Alex K: dumping per-replica metrics, `rwdctl pool metrics model-serving-gpu --window 5m`

Alex K: replica-1 queued spikes (queue_len 240), replica-1 gpu_mem 92%, others healthy. suspecting bursty KV-cache churn after a small model rollout earlier.

Maya R: we just pushed a small model tweak 20m ago, might have invalidated some cache entries. Is there a quick mitigation?

Priya S: we can divert a portion of traffic away from pool replica-1 via routing weight -> spin up an extra replica and drain the hot one.

Alex K: initiating scale out: `rwdctl pool scale model-serving-gpu --replicas 5` (was 4). Also setting drain on replica-1: `rwdctl replica drain replica-1 --grace 30s`

pagerduty-bot: PD-1927700321 acknowledged by Alex K

Sam P: toggled ephemeral prefix caching to aggressive-hit mode for 10m (`model.cache_hint=aggressive`) to reduce kvcache misses.

Alex K: new replica observed Ready at +120s. Rebalancing traffic. Watching latencies.

Alex K: p50 -> 110ms, p95 -> 380ms… trending down at 04:35Z

Maya R: any customer-visible timeouts?

Alex K: no 5xx, timeouts unchanged. Impact limited to tail latency on ~4% of requests during the spike window.

pagerduty-bot: PD-1927700321 - alert auto-resolved at 2026-11-02T04:35:51Z (metrics within thresholds)

Alex K: notes for RCA: transient kvcache churn due to recent rollout + one replica saturation. Mitigation: scaled + drained hot replica + cache hint. No customer errors.

Priya S: propose actions: 1) add 4m suppression window to PD latency-only rules to reduce flapping noise, 2) add per-replica mem-headroom metric and alert when >85% for >1m, 3) include cache-warmup step in rollout playbook.

Sam P: +1 on mem-headroom alert. Also suggest we add a small gradual rollout for cache-significant changes.

Maya R: I'm taking the RCA ticket. Alex, can you paste the scale/drain logs and the `rwdctl` outputs to OPS-3489?

Alex K: will do. dropping snippets here:
```
[04:32:05] replica-1 gpu_mem=92% queue_len=240 kvcache_miss=0.76
[04:33:10] scale => replicas=5
[04:34:15] new-replica ready (replica-5)
[04:35:30] p50=110ms p95=380ms
```

Priya S: opened OPS-3489 and added owners: Maya R, Sam P, Alex K. Tagging in dashboards and timelines.

Alex K: handoff: my shift ends in 40m, Maya will own follow-up. Key context: PD-1927700321, scaled 4->5, drained replica-1, cache hint toggled, recovered inside 4 minutes.

Maya R: got it. I'll coordinate the RCA and schedule a short postmortem sync if we see recurrence.

Alex K: one more ops note: plan to implement a 3m PD suppression for latency-only alerts where error rate unchanged. If anyone has concerns speak now. :wave:

Sam P: fine by me.

Priya S: ok

Maya R: fine

incident-bot: Thread auto-closed by system (no further activity).
